_meta.source: MOE post secondary admissions pages, MOE press releases on admission criteria changes for the first SEC cohort, ITE and polytechnic admissions pages
_meta.notes: Criteria apply to the first SEC cohort entering post secondary in 2028, admitted through the PSE (one exercise replacing the JAE, PFP and DPP exercises). Figures marked confirmed were corroborated against extracts of the primary MOE, SEAB and ITE pages plus two or more independent sources on 2026-08-05; the session could not open the primary pages end to end, so eyeball them once before students use this. Revised 2026-10-27 from search engine extracts of the MOE PSE pages: JC and MI need all five L1R4 subjects at G3; polytechnic B2 counts at its G2 equivalent; 3 year Higher Nitec is graded at G1; LASALLE and NAFA ask for G3 English. Structural rules are evaluated by the app. Performance rules are shown, and computed only from grades a student chooses to enter as targets.

moe_ite_upgraders.title: ITE upgrader admissions to polytechnics from AY2027

destinations.name: ITE, Higher Nitec, straight into Year 2
destinations.feels: Hands on from week one, on the equipment the industry uses.
destinations.leadsTo: Higher Nitec, then work or poly.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above

performance.label: ELMAB3 19 or better, at G2 grades
performance.note: From AY2028, this skips Year 1 of the same 3 year course. It replaced the DPP.

alsoIn: Early Admissions looks at interest, before results.

destinations.name: ITE, 3 year Higher Nitec
destinations.duration: 3 years, or leave with a Nitec after 2
destinations.feels: Learn a trade by doing it, in a workshop, kitchen or studio.
destinations.leadsTo: Higher Nitec, then poly or work. Nitec marks the exit stop.

structural.label: Four subjects at G1 or above

performance.label: Built to take the whole range of the cohort
performance.note: Counted at G1 equivalent grades on one of five aggregate types. No cut off is published; popular courses are competitive.

alsoIn: One course now, not two stacked ones. Leaving after Year 2 with a Nitec and returning later is a real road.

destinations.name: Junior College
destinations.feels: Fast and essay heavy. I narrow to a few subjects and go deep.

structural.label: English at G3
structural.note: L1 is English or Higher Mother Tongue; English must also reach C6.

structural.label: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3
structural.move: Take Mathematics, or Additional Mathematics, at G3
structural.note: A G3 Mathematics at D7 or better is a grade floor.

structural.label: A Humanities subject at G3
structural.move: Take a Humanities subject at G3
structural.note: R1 is a Humanities subject. Which arts subjects count is read from older JAE lists.

structural.label: Five subjects at G3
structural.note: All five subjects counted in L1R4 must be G3.

performance.label: L1R4 of 16 or better, all at G3
performance.note: English, a Humanities, a Maths or Science, one more of either, and one best other. Bonus points take off up to 3.

performance.label: Grade floors
performance.note: English C6 and a G3 Maths D7. Mother Tongue need not be G3: D7 at G3, 5 at G2 or D at G1 all count.

alsoIn: Direct School Admission takes talent, before results.

destinations.name: Millennia Institute
destinations.feels: The same A Levels as JC, over three years instead of two.

structural.label: English at G3
structural.note: L1 is English or Higher Mother Tongue; English must also reach C6.

structural.label: Mathematics or Additional Mathematics at G3
structural.move: Take Mathematics, or Additional Mathematics, at G3
structural.note: A G3 Mathematics at D7 or better is a grade floor.

structural.label: A Humanities subject at G3
structural.move: Take a Humanities subject at G3
structural.note: R1 is a Humanities subject. Which arts subjects count is read from older JAE lists.

structural.label: Five subjects at G3
structural.note: All five subjects counted in L1R4 must be G3.

performance.label: L1R4 of 20 or better, all at G3
performance.note: English, a Humanities, a Maths or Science, one more of either, and one best other. Bonus points take off up to 3.

performance.label: Grade floors
performance.note: English C6 and a G3 Maths D7. Mother Tongue need not be G3: D7 at G3, 5 at G2 or D at G1 all count.

alsoIn: Some students choose the extra year on purpose.

destinations.name: NAFA and LASALLE
destinations.feels: I audition or show a portfolio. The work is the entry.
destinations.leadsTo: A diploma, then a degree or practice.

structural.label: English at G3
structural.note: LASALLE and NAFA, 2028 intake: G3 English at C6 or better.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above
structural.note: 21 points or better across four other subjects, one of which may be G2.

performance.label: Portfolio or audition carries the most weight
performance.note: Results set the floor and the work decides: 21 points or better across four subjects besides English.

alsoIn: Start a portfolio now. It does not depend on my levels.

destinations.name: Polytechnic Foundation Programme
destinations.feels: A year inside the polytechnic, building the foundation my diploma needs.
destinations.leadsTo: Straight into Year 1 of a diploma.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above

performance.label: ELMAB3 12 or better
performance.note: English, Mathematics and three best, all counted at G2 equivalent grades. G3 grades map down, so any mix of levels can apply from the 2028 intake.

alsoIn: I apply into a cluster of related courses, and the diploma at the end is the same as everyone else's.

destinations.name: Polytechnic
destinations.feels: I pick a field on day one and work in it. Labs, studios, an internship.
destinations.leadsTo: A diploma, then work or university.

structural.label: Four subjects at G3
structural.note: English, two relevant subjects and the best other subject count at G3.

structural.label: Five subjects at G2 or above
structural.note: The fifth subject (B2) always counts at its G2 equivalent, so it can be a G2 subject.

structural.label: Mathematics at G2 or above
structural.note: Most courses ask for Mathematics; course minimums for 2028 are published mid 2027.

performance.label: ELR2B2 of 22 or better, after CCA points
performance.note: English, two relevant subjects and the best other at G3, plus a fifth at G2 value. Nursing reads 24.

performance.label: Grades that cannot count
performance.note: G3 grade 9, and G2 grades 5 and 6, cannot be used in the score. CCA can take off 2 points.

alsoIn: Early Admissions can give me a place before results.

destinations.name: A fifth year at school
destinations.feels: Same school, one more year, subjects at a harder level.
destinations.leadsTo: The SEC again, then any route.

structural.label: Decided on results, not my plan

performance.label: Three or more G3 passes
performance.note: And not qualifying for JC, MI or Polytechnic Year 1.

performance.label: Or ELMAB3 21, ELB3 14, or MAB3 14 at G2
performance.note: With two or fewer G3 passes, and Grade 5 at G2 in every subject counted. Taking every fifth year subject at G3 needs ELMAB3 19.

alsoIn: It exists so one year does not decide everything.
